claim_scope: Compatible ideal convention for vacuum-WPD Ramsey fringe only, and a caller-specified new constant-generator instance. Not a whole-paper reproduction.

source.reading_method: Visually inspected rendered PDF pages 2–3; source prose/images are not embedded in result.

source_supported: Ramsey sequence with two balanced qubit operations, relative phase, cavity as WPD, final computational readout.
Vacuum WPD does not collect path information in this ideal case.
Experimental phase is incorporated into the first microwave pulse by adjusting its phase (page 3).
explicit_chosen_convention: Basis |0>=|g>, |1>=|e>; column state vectors and left matrix action.
H1=H2=Ry(pi/2)= [[1,-1],[1,1]]/sqrt(2), both full matrices including chosen phases.
H1 prepares (|g>+|e>)/sqrt(2); final H2 gives the source minus-cosine ground readout.
Skill analyzer H D(-delta), delta=pi, equals chosen H2; chronological analyzer calls D(-pi), H.
Physical pulse phases, axes and common phase are not uniquely identified by the population curve; these matrices are an explicit compatible completion.
Caller evolution is placed between preparation and analysis; that mathematical new instance is distinct from the source implementation of phase in H1.

additional_chosen_checks.interpretation: Each scan phase is added after the new fixed evolution; first point phi_extra=0 is the requested new endpoint.
additional_chosen_checks.coherent_control_witness: Auxiliary mathematical phase-scope check supplied by runner; not claimed as the paper apparatus.

derivation.sign_convention: Positive excited-amplitude relative phase means c_e/c_g gains exp(+i*omega*t); with U=exp(-iGt), G= kappa I - omega |e><e|.
derivation.cyclic_to_angular: omega=2*pi*f; rad/s generator already equals H/hbar, so no hbar division is applied.
derivation.decomposition_phase_caution: Imposed kappa*t=0.17 is distinct from canonical ZYZ alpha and from total trace phase; retain the full generator and U.

comparison_metric_conversion.reason: Entrywise epsilon implies l2<=sqrt(d)*epsilon for d=2; matrix Frobenius<=2*epsilon. Local budgets do not imply an arbitrary accumulated-error theorem; final outputs checked separately.

phase_witness.note: Outside controlled tolerance is an intentional witness, not failure of the repaired evolution.

numerical_acceptance.note: Final coordinate max errors checked independently; Euclidean/Frobenius helper budgets are separately declared.
